description: One fixed-width edit (UPDATE Fx SET Fb = 200 WHERE ID = 5). Fx: ten rows on one small table (ID Long key; Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, Decimal Fm and a trailing Text Vt); row 8 is Null in Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft and Fm. Writer A opens the database read/write, makes the mutation, closes the database (DBEngine alive) and signals; process B kills A at once (TerminateProcess, verified own worker), waits 0.5 s, keeps the frozen file, opens it read-only with DAO and reads the public state. Process-termination model only.
retentionNote: Designed R-FMT-2 kill: participant a ends itself with TerminateSelf (exit 0xDEAD) after Close, so a seals Uncertain by design; participant b's answer is the evidence.
